subject: Accelerator pricing flexibility request — WedgeAI cohort
messages:
From: Anu Rao <anu@wedgeai.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: WedgeAI Procurement <procurement@wedgeai.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Flexible accelerator pricing for WedgeAI cohort?

Jordan —

Thanks again for the quick walkthrough yesterday. WedgeAI was accepted into the HIVE accelerator and the cohort starts May 1. Programs team is excited to include Redwood for model infra credits, but the standard promo package in your portal falls short for our expected ramp: we expect burst usage early (fine-tuning + inference) that will exceed the free tier.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood extend the promo credits for cohort participants from 3k -> 10k (per company) for the first 90 days?
- Can we get a short-term pilot discount on hosted inference (suggested 20% for 90 days) so founders can iterate without immediately hitting high bills?

We need to include this in the sponsor materials and call it out on the acceptance page by Monday. If possible, please send a short note with what you can offer (and any procurement terms) so we can finalize the sponsor pack.

Attached: HIVE acceptance memo (for context).

—Anu Rao
VP, Programs, WedgeAI
anu@wedgeai.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Anu Rao <anu@wedgeai.com>
Cc: WedgeAI Procurement <procurement@wedgeai.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Flexible accelerator pricing for WedgeAI cohort?

Hi Anu — great news, congrats to the cohort! Really appreciate the timeline note.

We can put a short-form sponsor concession in place. Two quick options I can share immediately:

Option A — Generous pilot (recommended):
- 10,000 free credits per accepted company, valid first 90 days
- 20% hosted inference consumption discount for first 90 days
- Requires signed PO and acceptance of our pilot T&Cs (amendment)

Option B — Conservative (finance-friendly):
- 6,000 free credits per company, valid first 60 days
- 12% discount for first 60 days
- Requires PO, limited to non-production (sandbox) workloads only

I attached a one-page pricing matrix and a short concession summary for program collateral. For legal and procurement, we typically require a PO and a short amendment (1–2 clauses) to ensure credits are timeboxed and non-transferable. If you can confirm which option you prefer I will run it through our finance/partnerships queue and pull a DocuSign ready envelope.

Would love to lock this before EOD Monday to make your acceptance page.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Startup & Accelerators
Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Flexible accelerator pricing for WedgeAI cohort? — approval request

Ben / Laura — forwarding WedgeAI request (see note from Anu). Cohort starts May 1; they need sponsor language by Monday. My recommended ask: Option B as baseline but I'm proposing a middle ground to get them locked: 6k credits + 15% discount, 90 days, require PO and sandbox limitation.

Why: high conversion potential (they run a lot of early-stage startups and we can surface Redwood in their mentor toolkit). Marketing/co-sell value is high if we are the featured infra sponsor. Ben, can you confirm partnership/marketing expectations? Laura, can we relax the credit ceiling to 6k and discount to 15% for 90 days if we get a PO + 30d payment terms?

Thanks —
Jordan

Jordan / Ben — finance constraints and required guardrails:
- We can approve up to 6,000 free credits per participant and a discount up to 12% without exec sign-off. Anything beyond that requires Director approval plus rev protection clauses.
- Credits must be explicitly timeboxed (90 days) and limited to sandbox/experimental workloads — no permanent production provisioning.
- We require a PO referencing DEAL-2028-047 and 30-day net payment terms for any billable consumption beyond credits.
- Legal should add a one-paragraph amendment that credits are non-transferable and expire on the 91st day.

I'll attach a short concession summary I want included with the DocuSign packet. If Jordan gets the PO and confirms marketing co-sell, we can route this today.

- 6,000 free Redwood credits per accepted company, valid for 90 days from activation
- 12% hosted inference consumption discount for the first 90 days
- Credits limited to sandbox/experimental workloads; production use excluded
- Requirement: signed PO referencing DEAL-2028-047 and execution of a short DocuSign amendment (we will send the envelope)
- Marketing: Ben will coordinate a single virtual workshop and a post-cohort case study opportunity as part of the sponsor deliverables

Attachments: wedgeai_pricing_matrix_v1.xlsx, redwood_concession_summary_20280330.pdf, WedgeAI_PO_template.docx
